entities.summary: Lucas Miltiades Miller was a Greek American immigrant, lawyer, Democratic politician, and Wisconsin pioneer. He served one term in the U.S. House of Representatives, representing Wisconsin's 6th congressional district during the 52nd Congress. He was the first Greek American member of the U.S. House of Representatives, and was an instrumental figure in the establishment and development of the city of Oshkosh, Wisconsin. He also served thirteen terms as chairman of the board of supervisors of Winnebago County, Wisconsin.
